game.name: Import Tuner Challenge (USA)
game.desc: Import Tuner Challenge on Xbox 360 takes tuning to an art form. The aim is not only to equip the fastest Japanese sports cars using the latest accessories, but to challenge and humiliate all the gang leaders in Tokyo, unleashed in a completely open environment. Equip twenty-three cars from the most prestigious brands (Subaru Impreza, Nissan Skyline GT-R, or Mitsubishi Lancer)
